{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check: are there any non-numeric values in 'revenue'?
print("\nAre there non-numeric characters in 'revenue'?")
print(df['revenue'].str.contains(r'[^\d.,]', na=False).any())

# Convert revenue to float, removing commas
print("\nConverting 'revenue' to float...")
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders
print("\nQA orders (revenue = 999999.99):")
qa_count = (df['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(qa_count)

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nRefunded orders:")
refunded_count = (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print(refunded_count)

# Check: are there any negative ages besides -1?
print("\nOther negative ages?")
print((df['customer_age'] < 0).sum())"}
